text: The search DB view now permits both byDate and byReceived in its new-header thread-move decision when mSortThreadsByRoot is false. That decision compares GetDateInSeconds against the thread newest date, and later calls MoveThreadAt when moveThread is true. Keep the mode-enablement fix separate from a claim that this particular comparison uses a received-time field; the inspected branch does not.
